"""Immutable values and typed failures for permit document discovery."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import override


class PermitDocumentMime(StrEnum):
    """A supported permit-document MIME type proved by its file signature."""

    PDF = "application/pdf"
    JPEG = "image/jpeg"
    PNG = "image/png"


class DiscoveryFailureKind(StrEnum):
    """Operator-actionable reasons a candidate file cannot be discovered safely."""

    INBOX_MISSING = "inbox_missing"
    INBOX_NOT_DIRECTORY = "inbox_not_directory"
    INBOX_UNREADABLE = "inbox_unreadable"
    FILE_UNREADABLE = "file_unreadable"
    SYMLINK_ESCAPE = "symlink_escape"
    REPARSE_POINT = "reparse_point"
    IDENTITY_MISMATCH = "identity_mismatch"
    UNSUPPORTED_EXTENSION = "unsupported_extension"
    UNSUPPORTED_MIME = "unsupported_mime"
    EXTENSION_MISMATCH = "extension_mismatch"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SourceProvenance:
    """Filesystem identities captured by the descriptor-bound discovery read."""

    inbox_root: Path
    root_device: int
    root_inode: int
    file_device: int
    file_inode: int
    file_modified_ns: int


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DiscoveryFailure:
    """One source path rejected before it can enter OCR or storage processing."""

    kind: DiscoveryFailureKind
    relative_path: Path | None
    detail: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PermitDocumentDiscoveryError(Exception):
    """A complete, operator-readable collection of discovery rejections."""

    failures: tuple[DiscoveryFailure, ...]

    @override
    def __str__(self) -> str:
        """Render every rejected source path for command-line operators."""
        return "; ".join(
            f"{failure.relative_path.as_posix() if failure.relative_path else '<inbox>'}: {failure.kind.value} ({failure.detail})"
            for failure in self.failures
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DiscoveredDocument:
    """One immutable, signature-verified source document ready for extraction."""

    absolute_path: Path
    relative_path: Path
    site_code: str | None
    mime_type: PermitDocumentMime
    byte_size: int
    sha256: str
    provenance: SourceProvenance


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DocumentDiscoveryBatch:
    """A complete scan preserving both usable documents and independent failures."""

    documents: tuple[DiscoveredDocument, ...]
    failures: tuple[DiscoveryFailure, ...]


class ExtractionMethod(StrEnum):
    """How text for one source page was obtained."""

    TEXT_LAYER = "text_layer"
    OCR = "ocr"


class ExtractionFailureKind(StrEnum):
    """Safe, operator-actionable extraction failure categories."""

    SOURCE_CHANGED = "source_changed"
    SOURCE_REPARSE = "source_reparse"
    SOURCE_ROOT_CHANGED = "source_root_changed"
    RESOURCE_LIMIT = "resource_limit"
    ENCRYPTED_PDF = "encrypted_pdf"
    CORRUPT_DOCUMENT = "corrupt_document"
    UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT = "unsupported_document"
    OCR_EXECUTABLE_MISSING = "ocr_executable_missing"
    OCR_LANGUAGE_MISSING = "ocr_language_missing"
    OCR_TIMEOUT = "ocr_timeout"
    OCR_FAILED = "ocr_failed"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DocumentExtractionError(Exception):
    """A typed extraction failure that is safe to persist for review."""

    kind: ExtractionFailureKind
    detail: str

    @override
    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.kind.value}: {self.detail}"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OcrResult:
    """Unconfirmed OCR output and the local engine version that produced it."""

    text: str
    engine_version: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OcrAvailability:
    """Whether the configured local OCR engine can process Korean and English."""

    available: bool
    engine_version: str | None
    languages: tuple[str, ...]
    failure_kind: ExtractionFailureKind | None
    detail: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ExtractedPage:
    """One 1-based source page preserved for human review."""

    page_number: int
    text: str
    method: ExtractionMethod
    engine_version: str | None

    @property
    def is_blank(self) -> bool:
        """Return whether the preserved page contains no usable text."""
        return not self.text.strip()

def _permit_type_candidates(pages: tuple[ExtractedPage, ...]) -> list[FieldCandidate]:
    candidates: list[FieldCandidate] = []
    for page in pages:
        lines = page.text[:_MAX_PAGE_CHARACTERS].splitlines()
        for line in lines:
            bounded_line = line[:_MAX_LINE_CHARACTERS]
            compact_line = _compact(bounded_line)
            for permit_type, keywords in _PERMIT_KEYWORDS:
                if any(_compact(keyword) in compact_line for keyword in keywords):
                    confidence = (
                        Confidence.HIGH
                        if any(token in compact_line for token in ("\ud5c8\uac00", "\uc2e0\uace0", "\ub4f1\ub85d"))
                        else Confidence.MEDIUM
                    )
                    candidates.append(
                        _candidate(
                            permit_type.value,
                            page,
                            bounded_line,
                            CandidateSource.PERMIT_KEYWORD,
                            confidence,
                        )
                    )
    return candidates


def _condition_candidates(pages: tuple[ExtractedPage, ...]) -> list[FieldCandidate]:
    candidates: list[FieldCandidate] = []
    for page in pages:
        lines = page.text[:_MAX_PAGE_CHARACTERS].splitlines()
        for index, line in enumerate(lines):
            bounded_line = line[:_MAX_LINE_CHARACTERS]
            match = _LABELED_LINE.match(bounded_line)
            if match is None or _compact(match.group("label")) not in _CONDITION_LABELS:
                continue
            parts = [match.group("value").strip()]
            for following in lines[index + 1 : index + 9]:
                bounded_following = following[:_MAX_LINE_CHARACTERS]
                if not bounded_following.strip():
                    break
                next_match = _LABELED_LINE.match(bounded_following)
                if next_match is not None and _compact(next_match.group("label")) in _STOP_LABELS:
                    break
                parts.append(bounded_following.strip())
            value = "\n".join(part for part in parts if part)[:_MAX_CONDITIONS_CHARACTERS]
            if value:
                evidence = "\n".join([bounded_line, *parts[1:]])[:_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARACTERS]
                candidates.append(
                    _candidate(value, page, evidence, CandidateSource.MULTILINE_LABEL, Confidence.HIGH)
                )
    return candidates


def extract_candidates(
    pages: tuple[ExtractedPage, ...], known_sites: tuple[SiteRef, ...]
) -> PermitCandidates:
    """Extract bounded, review-only candidate fields without mutating permit data."""
    labeled = _labeled_candidates(pages)
    return PermitCandidates(
        site=_field(_site_candidates(pages, known_sites)),
        permit_type=_field(_permit_type_candidates(pages)),
        permit_number=_field(labeled.permit_numbers),
        authority=_field(labeled.authorities),
        issued_on=_field(labeled.issued_dates),
        valid_from=_field(labeled.valid_from),
        valid_until=_field(labeled.valid_until),
        conditions=_field(_condition_candidates(pages)),
    )

"""Immutable values and typed failures for permit document discovery."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import override


class PermitDocumentMime(StrEnum):
    """A supported permit-document MIME type proved by its file signature."""

    PDF = "application/pdf"
    JPEG = "image/jpeg"
    PNG = "image/png"


class DiscoveryFailureKind(StrEnum):
    """Operator-actionable reasons a candidate file cannot be discovered safely."""

    INBOX_MISSING = "inbox_missing"
    INBOX_NOT_DIRECTORY = "inbox_not_directory"
    INBOX_UNREADABLE = "inbox_unreadable"
    FILE_UNREADABLE = "file_unreadable"
    SYMLINK_ESCAPE = "symlink_escape"
    REPARSE_POINT = "reparse_point"
    IDENTITY_MISMATCH = "identity_mismatch"
    UNSUPPORTED_EXTENSION = "unsupported_extension"
    UNSUPPORTED_MIME = "unsupported_mime"
    EXTENSION_MISMATCH = "extension_mismatch"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SourceProvenance:
    """Filesystem identities captured by the descriptor-bound discovery read."""

    inbox_root: Path
    root_device: int
    root_inode: int
    file_device: int
    file_inode: int
    file_modified_ns: int


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DiscoveryFailure:
    """One source path rejected before it can enter OCR or storage processing."""

    kind: DiscoveryFailureKind
    relative_path: Path | None
    detail: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PermitDocumentDiscoveryError(Exception):
    """A complete, operator-readable collection of discovery rejections."""

    failures: tuple[DiscoveryFailure, ...]

    @override
    def __str__(self) -> str:
        """Render every rejected source path for command-line operators."""
        return "; ".join(
            f"{failure.relative_path.as_posix() if failure.relative_path else '<inbox>'}: {failure.kind.value} ({failure.detail})"
            for failure in self.failures
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DiscoveredDocument:
    """One immutable, signature-verified source document ready for extraction."""

    absolute_path: Path
    relative_path: Path
    site_code: str | None
    mime_type: PermitDocumentMime
    byte_size: int
    sha256: str
    provenance: SourceProvenance


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DocumentDiscoveryBatch:
    """A complete scan preserving both usable documents and independent failures."""

    documents: tuple[DiscoveredDocument, ...]
    failures: tuple[DiscoveryFailure, ...]


class ExtractionMethod(StrEnum):
    """How text for one source page was obtained."""

    TEXT_LAYER = "text_layer"
    OCR = "ocr"


class ExtractionFailureKind(StrEnum):
    """Safe, operator-actionable extraction failure categories."""

    SOURCE_CHANGED = "source_changed"
    SOURCE_REPARSE = "source_reparse"
    SOURCE_ROOT_CHANGED = "source_root_changed"
    RESOURCE_LIMIT = "resource_limit"
    ENCRYPTED_PDF = "encrypted_pdf"
    CORRUPT_DOCUMENT = "corrupt_document"
    UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT = "unsupported_document"
    OCR_EXECUTABLE_MISSING = "ocr_executable_missing"
    OCR_LANGUAGE_MISSING = "ocr_language_missing"
    OCR_TIMEOUT = "ocr_timeout"
    OCR_FAILED = "ocr_failed"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DocumentExtractionError(Exception):
    """A typed extraction failure that is safe to persist for review."""

    kind: ExtractionFailureKind
    detail: str

    @override
    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.kind.value}: {self.detail}"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OcrResult:
    """Unconfirmed OCR output and the local engine version that produced it."""

    text: str
    engine_version: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OcrAvailability:
    """Whether the configured local OCR engine can process Korean and English."""

    available: bool
    engine_version: str | None
    languages: tuple[str, ...]
    failure_kind: ExtractionFailureKind | None
    detail: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ExtractedPage:
    """One 1-based source page preserved for human review."""

    page_number: int
    text: str
    method: ExtractionMethod
    engine_version: str | None

    @property
    def is_blank(self) -> bool:
        """Return whether the preserved page contains no usable text."""
        return not self.text.strip()

def _permit_type_candidates(pages: tuple[ExtractedPage, ...]) -> list[FieldCandidate]:
    candidates: list[FieldCandidate] = []
    for page in pages:
        lines = page.text[:_MAX_PAGE_CHARACTERS].splitlines()
        for line in lines:
            bounded_line = line[:_MAX_LINE_CHARACTERS]
            compact_line = _compact(bounded_line)

                        if any(token in compact_line for token in ("\ud5c8\uac00", "\uc2e0\uace0", "\ub4f1\ub85d"))
                        else Confidence.MEDIUM
                    )
                    candidates.append(
                        _candidate(

                            page,
                            bounded_line,
                            CandidateSource.PERMIT_KEYWORD,

def _condition_candidates(pages: tuple[ExtractedPage, ...]) -> list[FieldCandidate]:
    candidates: list[FieldCandidate] = []
    for page in pages:
        lines = page.text[:_MAX_PAGE_CHARACTERS].splitlines()
        for index, line in enumerate(lines):
            bounded_line = line[:_MAX_LINE_CHARACTERS]
            match = _LABELED_LINE.match(bounded_line)
            if match is None or _compact(match.group("label")) not in _CONDITION_LABELS:
                continue
            parts = [match.group("value").strip()]
            for following in lines[index + 1 : index + 9]:
                bounded_following = following[:_MAX_LINE_CHARACTERS]
                if not bounded_following.strip():
                    break
                next_match = _LABELED_LINE.match(bounded_following)
                if next_match is not None and _compact(next_match.group("label")) in _STOP_LABELS:
                    break
                parts.append(bounded_following.strip())
            value = "\n".join(part for part in parts if part)[:_MAX_CONDITIONS_CHARACTERS]
            if value:
                evidence = "\n".join([bounded_line, *parts[1:]])[:_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARACTERS]
                candidates.append(
                    _candidate(value, page, evidence, CandidateSource.MULTILINE_LABEL, Confidence.HIGH)
                )
    return candidates


def extract_candidates(
    pages: tuple[ExtractedPage, ...], known_sites: tuple[SiteRef, ...]
) -> PermitCandidates:

"""Immutable values and typed failures for permit document discovery."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import override


class PermitDocumentMime(StrEnum):
    """A supported permit-document MIME type proved by its file signature."""

    PDF = "application/pdf"
    JPEG = "image/jpeg"
    PNG = "image/png"


class DiscoveryFailureKind(StrEnum):
    """Operator-actionable reasons a candidate file cannot be discovered safely."""

    INBOX_MISSING = "inbox_missing"
    INBOX_NOT_DIRECTORY = "inbox_not_directory"
    INBOX_UNREADABLE = "inbox_unreadable"
    FILE_UNREADABLE = "file_unreadable"
    SYMLINK_ESCAPE = "symlink_escape"
    REPARSE_POINT = "reparse_point"
    IDENTITY_MISMATCH = "identity_mismatch"
    UNSUPPORTED_EXTENSION = "unsupported_extension"
    UNSUPPORTED_MIME = "unsupported_mime"
    EXTENSION_MISMATCH = "extension_mismatch"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SourceProvenance:
    """Filesystem identities captured by the descriptor-bound discovery read."""

    inbox_root: Path
    root_device: int
    root_inode: int
    file_device: int
    file_inode: int
    file_modified_ns: int


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DiscoveryFailure:
    """One source path rejected before it can enter OCR or storage processing."""

    kind: DiscoveryFailureKind
    relative_path: Path | None
    detail: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PermitDocumentDiscoveryError(Exception):
    """A complete, operator-readable collection of discovery rejections."""

    failures: tuple[DiscoveryFailure, ...]

    @override
    def __str__(self) -> str:
        """Render every rejected source path for command-line operators."""
        return "; ".join(
            f"{failure.relative_path.as_posix() if failure.relative_path else '<inbox>'}: {failure.kind.value} ({failure.detail})"
            for failure in self.failures
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DiscoveredDocument:
    """One immutable, signature-verified source document ready for extraction."""

    absolute_path: Path
    relative_path: Path
    site_code: str | None
    mime_type: PermitDocumentMime
    byte_size: int
    sha256: str
    provenance: SourceProvenance


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DocumentDiscoveryBatch:
    """A complete scan preserving both usable documents and independent failures."""

    documents: tuple[DiscoveredDocument, ...]
    failures: tuple[DiscoveryFailure, ...]


class ExtractionMethod(StrEnum):
    """How text for one source page was obtained."""

    TEXT_LAYER = "text_layer"
    OCR = "ocr"


class ExtractionFailureKind(StrEnum):
    """Safe, operator-actionable extraction failure categories."""

    SOURCE_CHANGED = "source_changed"
    SOURCE_REPARSE = "source_reparse"
    SOURCE_ROOT_CHANGED = "source_root_changed"
    RESOURCE_LIMIT = "resource_limit"
    ENCRYPTED_PDF = "encrypted_pdf"
    CORRUPT_DOCUMENT = "corrupt_document"
    UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT = "unsupported_document"
    OCR_EXECUTABLE_MISSING = "ocr_executable_missing"
    OCR_LANGUAGE_MISSING = "ocr_language_missing"
    OCR_TIMEOUT = "ocr_timeout"
    OCR_FAILED = "ocr_failed"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DocumentExtractionError(Exception):
    """A typed extraction failure that is safe to persist for review."""

    kind: ExtractionFailureKind
    detail: str

    @override
    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.kind.value}: {self.detail}"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OcrResult:
    """Unconfirmed OCR output and the local engine version that produced it."""

    text: str
    engine_version: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OcrAvailability:
    """Whether the configured local OCR engine can process Korean and English."""

    available: bool
    engine_version: str | None
    languages: tuple[str, ...]
    failure_kind: ExtractionFailureKind | None
    detail: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ExtractedPage:
    """One 1-based source page preserved for human review."""

    page_number: int
    text: str
    method: ExtractionMethod
    engine_version: str | None

    @property
    def is_blank(self) -> bool:
        """Return whether the preserved page contains no usable text."""
        return not self.text.strip()
